description: This file defines a utility class 'Toaster' that provides static methods to display success and error toast messages using a custom 'Toasty' class, enhancing user notifications within the Android app.

classes.name: Toaster
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for displaying styled toast notifications.

methods.name: successToast
methods.description: Displays a success toast with a check icon and themed colors.

methods.name: errorToast
methods.description: Displays an error toast with an error icon and themed colors.
